note:
v0.29.0 闭环收口：旅程复盘卡 + 记忆压缩 + 策略切换

· 旅程复盘：行程结束后自动生成一张可分享的复盘卡 —— 这趟说了几句、平均分多少、最常卡的是什么，并附「下一趟要说的第一句」（看完就能开口）。
· 记忆压缩：跨天事件自动压成日摘要（最多 30 天），原始事件用完即弃。零新增请求、零新增 KV 写。
· 策略切换：同一句连错 3 次，就不再重复它 —— 改为「拆音节练」或「换个说法」；一旦连对立刻解除，不贴永久标签。
noteEn:
v0.29.0 Closing the loop: trip retro, memory compaction, strategy switching

· Trip retro: an end-of-trip card you can share — how many lines you said, your average score, what tripped you up most, plus the first line to say on your next trip.
· Memory compaction: past-day events roll up into daily digests (30-day cap); raw events are consumed. No extra requests, no extra KV writes.
· Strategy switching: miss the same line 3 times and Sinoky stops repeating it — switching to sound-by-sound practice or another way to say it. Cleared the moment you break through.
